source.quote: MHDT Labs' own page for the Oolong, read 2026-11-25. The page's own heading reads « Pagoda DAC » above the « Oolong » title - an error on the maker's page, reported and not corrected. « Oolong DAC is a non over-sampling, no digital filter, structured DAC. » « Oolong DAC is capable of up to 24bits/192kHz digital signal inputs yet remains driving legendary PCM1704 R-2R digital to analog output. » « Oolong configured to be 24 bits output. » « All inputs support 16/24 bits/ 32 kHz up to 192 kHz » « Total five independent digital inputs; AES/EBU, BNC, USB, RCA and Toslink. » « Tube buffered output, tube installed is Sovtek 6922 tube. » « Digital Receiver CS8416 » « D/A converter PCM1704U-J (J grade) ». No DSD figure.

facts.chip: « D/A converter PCM1704U-J (J grade) » - the Burr-Brown 24-bit ladder, grade specified, with a « Digital Receiver CS8416 » and a « Sovtek 6922 » output tube.

device_settings.why: « a non over-sampling, no digital filter, structured DAC ». Nothing to set.

_verification_des_conditions_tentee_et_n: mhdtlab.com links no terms, legal or copyright page from its navigation, and the fetched pages carry no copyright footer at all - it is an old-style hand-built site. The reader was careful to say that this is « no terms page found, so no prohibition could be checked. This is not a finding of 'no prohibition.' » The facts are recorded, because the rule is to integrate unless explicitly forbidden and nothing forbidding was found; the quality of the check is recorded with them, as it was for Burson and Mytek.
_NOS_ici_veut_dire_NON_SUR_ECHANTILLONNE: This is the maker vocabulary/nos-means-two-things.json was most afraid of: tube-output converters, where NOS valves and non-oversampling meet on one page. The reader checked every page read on both sites and reported: « No fetched page from either site contains 'NOS' or 'New Old Stock.' » MHDT writes « non over-sampling » IN FULL, every time, and names its valve by type. So the ambiguity the vocabulary note predicted does not arise here - not because it was resolved, but because this maker never uses the abbreviation.
_le_SEUL_de_la_gamme_dont_la_sortie_est_: « Oolong configured to be 24 bits output », on a PCM1704U-J, against 16 bits on the Orchid's TDA1541A and 18 on the Istanbul's PCM61P-K. So on this one model the input depth and the conversion depth agree, and the eight bits the others discard are kept. The page's own heading calls it a Pagoda, which is a different model in the same family table - recorded because a reader checking this record against the page will see the wrong name at the top.
